title: J-2 can be tested on module-finite algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Suppose that for every commutative $R$-algebra $B$ which is finitely generated as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], the subset $\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}B:B_{\mathfrak q}\text{ is regular local}\}$ is Zariski open [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-regular-scheme]. Then for every finite type commutative $R$-algebra $C$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], the subset $\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}C:C_{\mathfrak q}\text{ is regular local}\}$ is Zariski open. Equivalently, $R$ is J-2 in the sense of [def-exc-excellent-ring].
